name: paper-polisher-pro
description: AI writing detector (author self-check) + academic polishing guidance + terminology protection, 100% local. 11-layer recalibrated rule engine + token-spectrum layer + length-routed fusion + optional supervised Qwen3-0.6B ONNX layer (AUROC 1.0 held-out) + LLM fingerprint attribution (GLM/DeepSeek/Qwen/Kimi/MiniMax/GPT/Claude/Gemini) + journal precheck + AIGC compliance label check + paragraph attribution + sentence-level rewrite suggestions (guidance, never auto-rewrite). author: DoctorQ Lab
changelog: v6.8.0: per-file process isolation for batch runs (--isolate auto: on when the supervised model is installed — the native onnxruntime layer is the crash source; each file runs in its own worker subprocess so a hard crash costs only that file; rc=2 input errors pass the friendly message through instead of being wrapped as crashes; deterministic equivalence on/off locked by test) + error-glossary extensions (worker crash / encoding / timeout) + a Traceback-residue hygiene lock + duplicate anti-patterns header removed (caught by the new docs test).
